rationale: The candidate gives a concrete test strategy supported by the preserved bundle: `InheritedFlags()` merges persistent flags and adds entries from `parentsPflags` only when absent from both the inherited set and `LocalFlags()` (`command.go:1695–1718`); `HasInheritedFlags()` delegates to `InheritedFlags().HasFlags()` (`command.go:1766–1769`); `HasAvailableInheritedFlags()` is documented as excluding hidden or deprecated inherited flags (`command.go:1788–1792`); and `NonInheritedFlags()` directly returns `LocalFlags()` (`command.go:1721–1723`). The proposed assertions accurately follow this evidence.
